---
title: "map_total_tests"
author: "Gianni Ardielli"
output: html_document
---

Goal:
Map 
- amount of tests by function
- percentage of "results the same" and "results correct"
Calculate how much tests are implemented for each function and evaluate if the
tests rely on real(results correct) or fake data(results the same).
This helps to show where more tests should be added.

# Setup

```{r setup}

pacman::p_load(dplyr, tibble, stringr, purrr,ggplot2,tidyr)

```






# RR

```{r RR pathways}
files <- list.files(
  path = "tests/testthat",
  pattern = "\\.R$",      # nur R-Dateien
  full.names = TRUE       # kompletter Pfad
)

# Function to extract test names from a file
extract_test_names <- function(file_path) {
  
  file_content <- readLines(file_path)
  file_content <- file_content[!grepl("^\\s*#", file_content)]  # remove comments
  
  # Extract test_that descriptions
  test_names <- regmatches(
    file_content,
    gregexpr('testthat::test_that\\("\\K[^"]+(?=", \\{)', 
             file_content, 
             perl = TRUE)
  )
  
  tibble(
    file = basename(file_path),
    test_name = unlist(test_names)
  )
}

# Read all files
all_tests <- map_dfr(files, extract_test_names)

# Categorize tests
results_summary <- all_tests %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      str_detect(test_name, regex("results correct", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "results correct",
      str_detect(test_name, regex("results the same", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "results the same",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  count(file, category)

results_summary
```
# Transform

```{r Transform}



results_transformed <- results_summary %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = sum(n),
    n_res_correct = sum(n[category == "results correct"]),
    percent_res_correct = round(n_res_correct / n_total * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_plot <- results_transformed %>%
  mutate(
    n_incorrect = n_total - n_res_correct
  ) %>%
  select(file, n_res_correct, n_incorrect) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_res_correct, n_incorrect),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "value"
  )

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = file, y = value, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "n_res_correct" = "darkgreen",
      "n_incorrect" = "grey"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "n_res_correct" = "results correct",
      "n_incorrect" = "results the same"
    ),
    name = ""
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Test File",
    y = "Number of Tests",
    title = "Test Results per File"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
print(results_transformed)

```
# Single path elements

```{r Single path elements}

file <- "tests/testthat/test-attribute_health.R"

file_content <- readLines(file)
file_content <- file_content[!grepl("^\\s*#", file_content)]

test_names <- regmatches(
  file_content,
  gregexpr(
    'testthat::test_that\\("\\K[^"]+(?=", \\{)',
    file_content,
    perl = TRUE
  )
)

all_tests <- tibble(
  test_name = unlist(test_names)
)

all_tests_parsed <- all_tests %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      str_detect(test_name, regex("results correct", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "results_correct",
      str_detect(test_name, regex("results the same", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "results_the_same",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # alles zwischen |...| extrahieren
    path_elements = str_extract_all(test_name, "(?<=\\|)[^\\|]+(?=\\|)")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(category))

#make columns per path element
df_wide <- all_tests_parsed %>%
  unnest_wider(
    path_elements,
    names_sep = "_"
  )

# Alle Pfadebenen in long format
df_long <- df_wide%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("path_elements_"),
    names_to = "level",
    values_to = "element"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(element))  # NA entfernen
df_counts <- df_long %>%
  group_by(level, element, category) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
df_counts_wide <- df_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = category,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )



```

# go into  paths

```{r go into  paths}
#drop all colums with na
df_clean <- df_wide %>%
  select(where(~ !any(is.na(.))))

df_addup <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    path_elements_2 = paste(path_elements_1 , path_elements_2 , sep = "|"),
    path_elements_3 = paste(path_elements_2 , path_elements_3 , sep = "|"),
    path_elements_4 = paste(path_elements_3 , path_elements_4 , sep = "|"),
    path_elements_5 = paste(path_elements_4 , path_elements_5 , sep = "|"),
    path_elements_6 = paste(path_elements_5 , path_elements_6 , sep = "|"),
    path_elements_7 = paste(path_elements_6 , path_elements_7 , sep = "|")
  )
# change to long format
df_long <- df_addup%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("path_elements_"),
    names_to = "level",
    values_to = "element"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(element))  # filter NA
df_counts <- df_long %>%
  group_by(level, element, category) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
df_counts_wide <- df_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = category,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )
df_by_path <- df_counts_wide %>%
  separate(element, into = paste0("level_split_", 1:7), sep = "\\|", fill = "right")

```
